content.comment_body: Hello everyone! Does anyone know how to automatically synchronize [product_name] with GPS time in our system? Currently, our setup relies on a shared GPS clock for time synchronization.

Which version of [product_name] are you using? If you have [product_name] with [version_no] equal to or higher than FS:04, you can take advantage of the built-in NTP client to synchronize the device's clock, provided your time system offers an NTP server.

analysis.insight_summary: A user wants an automatic way to synchronize their [product_name] clock with a GPS-based system, preferring a simple solution. Another user responds that devices with newer hardware versions (FS:04 or above) have an integrated NTP client, making synchronization possible if an NTP server is available. The discussion brings attention to the importance of device version for accessing specific features.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects [product_name] to enable automatic synchronization of its internal clock with their GPS-based system, preferring a solution that doesn't require complex setup or repeated manual intervention.
